records.message: simulation 7001's group polars are read from the loads export of an unsteady run, its LAST TIME STEP, one instant of a cycle, because no averaging window resolves for it; the manifest marks them kind: instant.
no row in the settings table: its record holds no solver-setup snapshot; run the point again to record it
no point of the matrix has a solver-setup snapshot, so the settings table and its codebook are not written

the run record carries no reduction windows, so no reduction of the plots table can say which steps it averaged; the record was written before the field existed or by hand. Rerun the row, and the record will carry the windows its row states.
records.remedy: restore the required data or correct the stated inputs and post again.
